lines: Welcome to rehearsal! Tonight's play: The Silent Hand, the legend who never lost a duel.
Mime and Cue will warm you up. Then come and copy me. I mean, duel me.
Every great actor starts by copying.
On my stage, your last throw stays on the floor, so we can both see it.
Bravo! An original performance.
The Mirror stamp is yours.
That play… it's about me, you know.
I was the Silent Hand. I never lost, because I never stopped reading people.
Then I thought a lottery would spare everyone the tears, and I stopped duelling. I was wrong. Duels are how we learn to see each other.
So it's true. Hale was the Silent Hand…
I joined the Council because I hate losing. One more duel. If you win, I'll listen.
You read me. Even with all my studying.
I won… but it didn't feel like a lottery would. It felt earned.
A lottery means nobody learns anything. I'm with you. Let's stop Ren.

win.goal: Confront the Student Council: their room is at the east end of the corridor.

lines: You were a wonderful mirror. Try changing the script.
Mime and Cue first, darling. Every star needs a warm-up.
The transfer student. I've read every duel you've had.
Vale and Quill will see you first.
The lottery drum is in storage. If you want a rematch, find me at the festival stage.
Very well. Not here.
The festival stage, tonight, in front of the whole school. If you win, duels stay. If I win, the lottery begins.
My Secretary and Treasurer first. I don't waste time on unread files.
Students of Knuckle Academy! Tonight we decide: duels, or the fair way.
Step up, transfer student.
Go on. Read Ren the way you've read everyone else.

fest_intro.goal: Walk up to Ren on the festival stage.

then.line: A rematch? That's what duels are for, after all.

lines: I've read every duel you've had today. Begin.
As expected. The lottery would have been kinder. Come back when you're ready.
…You broke my reading.
No more reading, then. Phase two: best of five, and I play to win.
…Duels stay. You've earned that.
I wanted a school where nobody loses. You showed me losing is how we learn to read each other.

win.goal: After the story: rematch anyone and collect every outfit.

lines: Phase two is mine. Talk to me when you want to try again.
